reviews.author: THERESA B.
reviews.title: Not loving it
reviews.body: I love my black, but not living the brown color. I thought I’d try a color, wish I had found a smaller sized product to buy and now I’m stuck with a color I won’t wear. I won’t make that mistake again. Should’ve tried the grey NOT the brown.

reviews.author: Nancy S.
reviews.title: Mascara
reviews.body: I have very thin lashes. Comes out of tube way to thick and messy

reviews.author: Brandie S.
reviews.title: Bummed!
reviews.body: I have used this for a couple of years and I loved it but now I feel like maybe they changed the formula or ingredients. It makes my eyes burn now and it never did that before.

reviews.author: Angela F.
reviews.title: Liquid Lash Extensions Tubing Mascara
reviews.body: I have a lot of trouble with it smudging and getting on my eyelids and under my eyes when I put it on. I won't purchase it again.

reviews.author: Jennifer B.
reviews.title: Mascara clumps and a tube
reviews.body: Mascara clumps and a tube doesn’t last very long.

reviews.author: Eva R.
reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.body: No different than any other mascara

reviews.author: Kathleen M.
reviews.title: colored mascara
reviews.body: I tried the purple mascara. Unfortunately it doesn't look purple on dark lashes

reviews.author: Judith C.
reviews.title: I Want to Love the Tubing Mascara
reviews.body: It was great for the first 2 uses then, yesterday, I went to pull the wand out of the tube and the whole brush assembly separated from the wand and cap. It is now useless. I am hoping someone at Thrive can help me

reviews.author: Heidi S.
reviews.title: Just ok
reviews.body: Overall it was just ok. I have very long lashes and most mascaras work very well. This clumped a lot on my lashes my first use, didn’t add length or thicken so it wasn’t what I thought at all. I used black/brown but I have the green to use which I hope at least shows some color.

reviews.author: Amanda F.
reviews.title: Not a fan
reviews.body: I really don’t think it’s worth the money. I get better results with one coat of L’Oreal and it doesn’t look like tarantula legs. The wand is also heavy so I have to keep my hand super steady. Seems unnecessary. Won’t buy again.

reviews.author: Jamie P.
reviews.title: Flakey mascara
reviews.body: Flakes so will not buy again

reviews.author: Amy
reviews.title: Bad for contacts
reviews.body: I wanted this to work out good for me since I wear contacts and have dry eyes. Unfortunately, it looked nice but it irritated my eyes so bad I can’t wear it again.

reviews.author: Debbie T.
reviews.title: Lash Mascara
reviews.body: It does no better than the drug store brand. My eyelashes do not look any different. Would not buy again

reviews.author: Megan M.
reviews.title: Bummed Out
reviews.body: Got the berry color of the mascara is dark and I have blonde eyelashes. After a few hours it started to flake off. I'll probably have to supplement with other products if I feel like it.

reviews.author: Samantha g.
reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.body: Removes with ease. After 5 hours it is flaking on my face. There is a smear of the color on my lids as well.

reviews.author: Erin H.
reviews.title: don’t like tubing
reviews.body: Does not look natural like regular mascars

reviews.author: Kimberly H.
reviews.title: Not a fan of purple
reviews.body: The purple color was NOTHING like the black. It didn't grip the lash and it was dry. I was told its the exact same,formula but I dont believe it.

reviews.author: Virginia K.
reviews.title: Too much
reviews.body: Guess it does what it says - but too thick - easily clumped.

reviews.author: Angela R.
reviews.title: Dont bother
reviews.body: Comes off easy. Goes on clumpy

reviews.author: Kierlan S.
reviews.title: It’s ok
reviews.body: It just clumps together too easily. I tried a few different techniques. Tried doing one layer at a time so that it wouldn’t look like spider legs. It doesn’t add much length compared to any other mascara. The color is nice in the sunlight but compared to another brown mascara it isn’t a huge difference. I will try to put the first layer of my normal mascara that doesn’t clump my lashes together first then put this mascara over it for the color but I don’t think I would buy from this brand again.

reviews.author: Carma S.
reviews.title: Just ok
reviews.body: I use this just to touch up after my Lancome mascara. It flakes and comes off in big chunks when I use it alone using it just as a touchup works OK. I won’t order this product again.

reviews.author: Tina F.
reviews.title: Loved the lengthening
reviews.body: Loved how long it made my lashes BUT by the end of the day my eyes and eyelids were red and irritated. Not to mention we were at the ball fields all day so I was hot and sweaty. When I got to a mirror I had mascara smudges under my eyes. I did request a refund and received it quickly.

reviews.author: Deb G.
reviews.title: So/ So
reviews.body:
I have used this in the past and had luck. After using it a while it started to flake, I assumed it was old and that was the reason it was flaking. I ordered a new/ replenished “Liquid Lash” product and the first time I wore it flaked so bad…. I was embarrassed! 
What is the trick to prevent the product from flaking????

reviews.author: Deb
reviews.title: Love but disappointed
reviews.body: I love this mascara and the way it makes my lashes look-never clumpy at all. However, of the three tubes I have ordered, two of those tubes have come apart when removing the lid from the tube. The top of the tube separates and gets stuck inside the larger tube and is then unusable. I'm so disappointed because I really do love this mascara!

reviews.author: Mary A.
reviews.title: Uber Disappointed Longtime Tubing Mascara User
reviews.body:
After following their restocking I was thrilled when the newest colors, Ivy and Iris finally became available. 
I loved how vibrant they looked on your website as well as in the tube. Neither lived up to their predecessors (I have been using your colored mascaras for the past few years). 

Both show little color as well as wearing like regular mascara & not your tubing mascara that I've come to love. To ensure that I wasn't being fair, I asked several friends. They agreed. The same friends that have always noticed the other thrive colors I have been loving.

reviews.author: Jade J.
reviews.title: Just ok. .
reviews.body: I wanted to love it but I don’t. It doesn’t have nearly enough volume. I don’t like having to apply several coats. And even then I don’t love it

reviews.author: Jackie H.
reviews.title: Feedback
reviews.body: Very disappointed with the product I was excited when I ordered it because I do have the green eyes in the purple mascara was supposed to do wonders, but I get better results with my over-the-counter cosmetics. It was very disappointing.

reviews.author: Lisa B.
reviews.title: Mascara not worth the money
reviews.body: You have to apply two coats of the mascara or you wouldn't even know it's there. It doesn't look purple, it looks like light black.

reviews.author: Darlene R.
reviews.title: Mascara not what I expected
reviews.body: First, I am 76 years old. I have long lashes and use mascara everyday. When I tried the mascara for the first time I put on a thin layer. When it dried, my lashes were very stiff and hard. I used my little eyelash comb to separate my lashes. It flaked and lashes stayed stiff and hard. Of all the mascara I have used this was one of the worst. Disappointed and sorry that I won’t be using it again.

reviews.author: CEC
reviews.title: Eyelids Swollen to the size of Golfballs
reviews.body: I really wanted to love this makeup. I have by eyeing for quite a while. I liked the way it went on and that it stayed on and came off easy when I wanted it to. Day 3, eyes began to itch. Day 4 swollen up like golf balls. Stopped using for a week then tried back one at a time. Same reaction. Not sure what is in them but it is the only time I have had such a severe reaction.

reviews.author: megan h.
reviews.title: Mascara is amazing but got gunky when I travelled
reviews.body: Love this mascara but I put it in my make up bag in my suitcase for a weekend flight and when I landed it was super gunky all over the lash brush. Now it applies on very chunky and uneven and I just bought this product - bummed because I love this mascara

reviews.author: Stephanie
reviews.title: Bought the iris
reviews.body: Meh. Bought the mascara in color iris. Loved how it looks on line. Looks like regular black mascara on me.

reviews.author: Rashu
reviews.title: Not as good as before
reviews.body: I have used this mascara for a long time and absolutely loved it. For the past few months, the quality has deteriorated significantly. The applicator brushes are not as soft and easy to apply as they used to be. I am in the market for mascara again.

reviews.author: Ellen G.
reviews.title: Poor product
reviews.body: I received my lip stain, loved it, best I have ever used, however, used 3 times and is either out or just doesn't work. You have to press very hard, Very disappointed, cosmetics are expensive. This should have been made with a twist botto.

reviews.author: Laura B.
reviews.title: Not my favorite
reviews.body: Really wanted to love this. The ads hit me hard and even the girl at the ups store when she handed me the package said it was her top choice. To me, this was clumpy, have very little definition or length to my lashes. I get better results with drugstore brands. A bummer since I bought two.

reviews.author: Nancy S.
reviews.title: Dissatisfied
reviews.body: I did not find this product without flakiness and was very disappointed. I requested a refund and sent the product back using the provided shipping label. Instead of getting a refund, I was sent another tube of the mascara at no charge except tax. Why would I want more of a product l did not like???

reviews.author: Donna S.
reviews.title: MScars
reviews.body: It goes on ok but taking off it pulled my lashes out

fields.Location:
3928 Merced St
Des Moines IA 50310

I would like a

reviews.author: Linda D.
reviews.title: Never had mascara that comes
reviews.body: Never had mascara that comes off in small pieces. very weird.

reviews.author: Kate B.
reviews.title: Not a fan
reviews.body:
I was excited to try this but honestly am not a fan. This feels very heavy on my eyelashes and found it easily flakes for me. 

The color I got was also recommended for blue eyes and I didn't find it flattering at all.

reviews.author: Shana
reviews.title: Used to love
reviews.body: I have been using Thrive mascara for several years. It does not feel like it’s the same product as it was. It does not stick to my lashes and provide volume and length like it used to. I’m also noticing that my eyes burn off and on throughout the day. This was my go to, no fail product and I’m super disappointed.

reviews.author: Betty S.
reviews.title: Not worth the money
reviews.body: Nice packaging. Quick ship. Product itself dries hard and clumpy. Didn't get anymore length than I do with my current mascara.

reviews.author: Ressia S.
reviews.title: No difference in color
reviews.body: I couldn't notice any difference with the color. I was disappointed. Maybe your eyelashes have to be light to see it. It felt like a waste of money, Unfortunately.

reviews.author: Judy C.
reviews.title: Not happy
reviews.body:
I bought this as a trio with liner and highlighting stick. The mascara comes out in clumps on my lashes
I am not happy with it

reviews.author: Emmy J.
reviews.title: I dont like it. 😏
reviews.body: I bought 3 colors I was the most i interested in the berry brown and that was the worst color. It looked more like a chestnut brown on me. I have dark hair and lashes and it was not flattering on me. The deep purple was the prettiest but! It made my eyelashes not look good. It was very clumpy and I had trouble shaping my eyelashes. The good thing is it lasts long but the i felt like i needed a tool to separate my lashes. It also didnt give too much of a lift. I ended up using this and then my go to mascara together and it was the only thing that made me like it. I need the lash length and beautiful way my go to mascara works on my lashes but in Thrives colors.

reviews.author: Norma D.
reviews.title: I don't know how it
reviews.body: I don't know how it happened, but I received a charcoal color instead of black. I have blonde lashes, so you can barely see my lashes. Not the look I was going for. Will have to reorder. I typically love my thrive mascara

reviews.author: Holly H.
reviews.title: Tried twice, failed me both times.
reviews.body: I wanted to love this stuff. I bought it years ago and loved it for about a month, and then it suddenly started clumping and flaking on me. I decided to give it another chance and this time, the first time I wore it, it started transferring to my eyelids within an hour. I was so bummed to spend good money on a product that just smeared all over my skin. I had to keep checking my eyelids all day and felt very self conscious.

reviews.author: Lauren M.
reviews.title: eh at best
reviews.body: Yikes… Don’t find it at all smooth. Immediately getting clumps. Disappointed!!

reviews.author: Marilyn l.
reviews.title: Mascara is very clumpy and
reviews.body: Mascara is very clumpy and almost impossible to apply to my bottom lashes. I will not buy this mascara again.

reviews.author: MHall
reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.body: I question the reviews on this mascara. Very gloppy & difficult to get off. Used once & discarded.

reviews.author: Vanessa T.
reviews.title: Doesn't work for me
reviews.body: I was very excited to try it but unfortunately it didn't work for me. My lashes get lumpy and get stuck together. I got 2 tubes so I'm stuck with them. The one good thing is that the formula doesn't make my eyes watery. At the end my lashes get super flat, not a fan.

reviews.author: Meryl S.
reviews.title: Clumpy
reviews.body: Went on too thick and made lashes look clumpy

reviews.author: Kim M.
reviews.title: Not the same tubing mascara…
reviews.body: Not sure if the formula has changed in the past it was great I got a tube of Crystal and Bryn both did not extend lashes as in past and mascara is dry not luxurious feeling and doesn’t come off as it did in the past huge disappointment. The formula must have changed no additional length or volume

reviews.author: Jenelle K.
reviews.title: Not that impressive
reviews.body: I usually get e. l. f. tubing mascara for about $7 and love it, but I’ve heard so many great things about Thrive’s mascara, I finally took the plunge. For $25+ I bought their tubing mascara and was not too impressed. The mascara clumps, even if you put just one coat on. Two? Forget about it. You basically get 3 fat lashes because they’re all stuck together. I also found that it started flaking off after a couple hours of wear leaving me with black flecks all over my face. It was not the easiest to remove, but it wasn’t the hardest. It does make your lashes look longer, but so does e. l. f. for about $20 cheaper.

reviews.author: Bonnie H.
reviews.title: Mine is clump
reviews.body: Mine is clump

fields.Skin Concerns: Redness, Uneven Skin, Fine Lines + Wrinkles

reviews.author: Kristan W.
reviews.title: Gray Tubing Mascara
reviews.body: It barely shows. I should have ordered the brown black as I did the last time.

reviews.author: Lisa W.
reviews.title: Something changed?
reviews.body: Has the formula changed? First time I purchased I loved it. Thought it was the best. Most recent order doesn’t seem to go on as well and tube like before.

reviews.author: Katherine S.
reviews.title: Yes it flakes off
reviews.body: This is supposed to be flake free but I get little chunks of mascara on my face.

reviews.author: Cathy S.
reviews.title: It’s ok as mascara goes
reviews.body: It’s ok as mascara goes but I found it has a tendency to clump and not separate the lashes as well as I had expected. I’m glad I tried this product but will more than likely not purchase again

reviews.author: Kathleen D.
reviews.title: Beautiful but bottle fail made it unusable
reviews.body:
Love the look of the green mascara - it creates a super long layer on top of my lashes and the color is subtle but adds a nice pop when I'm wearing dark green. Also like how easy it is to remove (no eye makeup remover necessary - the "tubes" just slide off with water. )

Unfortunately, the ring around the top of the tube came off after using it only a few times, so all the mascara just globs onto the brush when I pull it out of the tube. I'm not sure how to fix it and just wiping the brush along the edge leaves too much of the mascara on it to be able to use. Not sure if I would pay this much again for something I can only use a couple of times.

reviews.author: Patricia N.
reviews.title: It was almost dried out.
reviews.body: It was almost dried out. I would not order again.

reviews.author: Sarah C.
reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.body:
I am not a regular mascara user, only use about once a week. I wanted to love this product but so far I don’t. The first time I used it, it smeared and looked terrible.
The 2nd time I used it, I wiped some of the mascara off the brush so it would not be so thick on my lashes, it still smeared and left little clumps on my eyes. I am now afraid to use it because in the summer heat and when I cry it leaves my eyes a mess.
I’m glad this company is for a worthy cause but I will not purchase again.

reviews.author: Elaine H.
reviews.title: Eye lashes
reviews.body: Another disappointing purchase. It did not extend the lashes at all.

reviews.author: Wendy L.
reviews.title: This is my first time
reviews.body: This is my first time trying Thrive. I have worn tubing mascara for several years and wanted to try Thrive since my sister swears by it. Well I may have gotten a bad batch. The mascara creates long beautiful lashes upon application however it flakes terribly within the first hour and all throughout the day.

reviews.author: Allison G.
reviews.title: So thick?
reviews.body: I don’t know if it is me or if the formula changed or I got a bad batch but this mascara is so thick and makes my lashes stick together. I am so bummed.

reviews.author: JODIE J.
reviews.title: Skip this one
reviews.body: I am not a fan of this mascara. It applies to heavily. Not good for a second touchup. My eyelashes actually pulled out with this when removing with water as instructed. It’s also brown and I ordered the black. I would pass on this tubing mascara.

reviews.author: marilyn g.
reviews.title: Not happy with this product
reviews.body: I’ve used thrive mascara before but this particular one does not measure up. It’s too thick, difficult to remove and clumps.

reviews.author: Denise N.
reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.body: Not happy at all with this tubing mascara. Did not thicken my lashes as other tubing mascaras did. Will be returning it.

reviews.author: Susan S.
reviews.title: Not completely sure.
reviews.body: I can’t get it to stay on my lashes. It flakes off so bad. I am so disappointed. I was hoping to be able to say that it is perfect but I can’t. Very disappointed. But I will finish the tube. Maybe it will get better as I use it more.

reviews.author: Suzanne H.
reviews.title: Burgundy crumbled off
reviews.body: The burgundy color is amazing. However, as with another brand of tubing mascara I tried, it crumbled off throughout the day and was hardly visible by afternoon. Maybe my lashes are to fine? Oily? I was disappointed because the color looks fantastic with grey eyes.

reviews.author: Brea W.
reviews.title: Clumpy upon application.
reviews.body: Clumpy upon application.

reviews.author: Melanie M.
reviews.title: Comes off if you sweat at all
reviews.body: I was disappointed. I live in hot & humid Alabama. The first time I wore it and sweated just a bit it came off under my eyes. Big black/brown clumps. This was just getting into a hot car before the air conditioner cooled it down. It won't work for me at all.

reviews.author: Patricia M.
reviews.title: I wanted to love it!
reviews.body: I wanted to love it, but it wasn’t what I expected. Although I didn’t get raccoon eyes, it flaked and was clumpy.

reviews.author: Jennifer R.
reviews.title: Unimpressed
reviews.body: Clumpy, difficult to remove. I was really hoping for something good, but found this difficult to apply, spidery-looking, and I had clumps landing on my cheeks for days after using it, even after two showers and multiple attempts to remove with warm water, micellar water, and facial cleanser.

fields.Skin Concerns: Redness, Puffiness, Oil Control, Fine Lines + Wrinkles, Visible Pores

reviews.author: Maureen G.
reviews.title: A disappointing mascara
reviews.body: The wand is heavy. the product formula is thick. After multiple attempts, it doesn't provide lash lengthening or full lash appearance.

reviews.author: Debbie T.
reviews.title: Not worth it
reviews.body: My regular brand at half the price does a better job. Thrive mascara was difficult to apply due to clumps. It was very difficult to wash off. Will not buy again.

reviews.author: Debra B.
reviews.title: Mascara
reviews.body: Not impressed— goes on heavy and clumps.

reviews.author: Stephanie K.
reviews.title: Liquid lash extension mascara in brown
reviews.body: I have tried the liquid lash extension tubing mascara in black many times. However, I wanted to try and go lighter so I ordered the mascara in brown. However, I find that the black mascara makes my lashes longer and the brown does not. I am disappointed in the brown tubing mascara. Can I exchange it for the black?

reviews.author: Tracey B.
reviews.title: So so
reviews.body: I’m not too thrilled with this mascara. I was blessed with long lashes and people often ask “are those your lashes?” With this mascara I feel that my lashes disappear. Perhaps I chose a bad color (classic blue) but I am unsure if I will purchase again. Especially since it is quite pricy.

reviews.author: Deborah S.
reviews.title: I like it but I
reviews.body: I like it but I don’t like how hard it is to remove and the fact that the bits of mascara are hard to remove from all around my eyes once I remove it from my lashes.

reviews.author: Oksana M.
reviews.title: I gave it a try
reviews.body: I gave it a try and once again experienced lack of “extension” with a color other than “rich black”. Each time I get anything other than black, the extension effect is missing

reviews.author: Marcia R.
reviews.title: Not impressed with overall results
reviews.body: I am on day three of using this mascara and still not impressed. I put it on just as instructed and I end up with one eye clumping. The first eye is okay, not as nice as the video example, but okay. I wait a minute then go to the other eye and I get clumps that I have to comb out. Which ends up removing a lot of the product. I’ve tried less time and more time between eyes and get the same results. I will not be buying again.

reviews.author: Iryna G.
reviews.title: allergic reaction
reviews.body: Unfortunately, I had a severe allergic reaction to this mascara. It applies beautifully and is very easy to remove, but after using it, my eyes started watering and sticking together. The skin around the outer corners of my eyes became red, irritated, itchy, and flaky. Sadly, I can no longer use this product and would like to request a refund.

reviews.author: Elizabeth K.
reviews.title: Mascara
reviews.body: Average mascara, at best.

reviews.author: Bobbie g.
reviews.title: Not impressed
reviews.body: Just ok. Not impressed at all

reviews.author: Krystle F.
reviews.title: Not able to build up.
reviews.body: Not able to build up. My lashes still look small and clumpy.

reviews.author: Jennifer H.
reviews.title: Great if you like flaking 10 minutes after you apply it
reviews.body: Flakes so badly! I wasn’t even out of my bathroom, and already had flakes under my eyes and on my face. This is my second tube of this mascara. The first one wasn’t like this. Maybe they changed the formula? Idk, but it’s awful now.

reviews.author: Julie D.
reviews.title: Underwhelming and not what I hoped
reviews.body: My mascara arrived very think and clumsy :(. It makes my eyelashes stick together and it does not lengthen or enhance them. They do not look like the videos :(

fields.Skin Concerns: Redness, Fine Lines + Wrinkles, Uneven Skin, Visible Pores, Puffiness

reviews.author: Donna N.
reviews.title: Sorry. . . Disappointed in Thrive Mascara
reviews.body: I don't care for the mascara because it feels very stiff and hard.

reviews.author: Anne Q.
reviews.title: Tubing mascara
reviews.body:
I don't like saying this but please bring back your extension (non tubing) mascara. I very much dislike the tubing. It is hard to apply (clumps badly) and difficult to remove. 
If you think that I'm not applying correctly or something else, please let me know.

reviews.author: Anna C.
reviews.title: I paid for 2 and
reviews.body: I paid for 2 and only got 1. I wrote to Customer Service and didn’t get am answer, still waiting…

reviews.author: Shey C.
reviews.title: Bummed
reviews.body: I had high hopes for this based on all of the ads I saw. But it didn’t give me the look everyone was talking about, sadly.

reviews.author: Bev
reviews.title: Clumps too much
reviews.body: I'm 68 so I tried this mascara in hopes of "plumping" up my thinning lashes. It clumped up far more than any mascara I've ever tried. I just didn't like the look at all. I kept trying it in hopes that I'd do better in applying it. Nope. Still clumped. I wanted to like because it did lengthen my lashes. I went back to cover girl.

reviews.author: Linda B.
reviews.title: Not worth the price
reviews.body: Not as advertised in the commercials, l get better results from less expensive products lve used.

reviews.author: Linda J.
reviews.title: Not Meant For Me
reviews.body: This mascara clogged my lower eye lids and resulted in the same issue of sties that I was hoping to resolve by switching brands.

reviews.author: Kimber S.
reviews.title: Not Quite
reviews.body: This mascara does lengthen amazingly but it clumps and if you manually separate the tubing makes the length come off. It is messy.

reviews.author: Myra R.
reviews.title: Waste of my money
reviews.body: Neither product look like what was advertised and not easily applied as advertised

reviews.author: Patricia L.
reviews.title: I don't like the way
reviews.body: I don't like the way it's kinda stretchy when you pull on it and it does get flaky.

reviews.author: Monique G.
reviews.title: Quality changed
reviews.body: Formula is different my eyes got irritated and red smudged all over after a few hours

reviews.author: Amy M.
reviews.title: Not for me.
reviews.body: It didn't work for me. Was thick and made my lashes clump together. Even worse, it irritated the heck out of my eyes when I was trying to remove it. Glad it works well for some people, but I returned it.

reviews.author: Deb
reviews.title: Different results
reviews.body: I always loved the results and recomended to my daughters. But for some reason this tube has clumped on my lashes. I tried wiping the excess product off thinking there was too much maskara on the wand, still not okay. Really disappointed.

reviews.author: aec
reviews.title: Not good for small, hooded eyes with sparse lashes
reviews.body: I had high hopes for this mascara, but I was let down in many ways. Having small hooded eyes with sparse lashes here are my concerns 1) The wand is so long and large that it made it difficult to reach my lashes. 2) The formula is very wet, which weighed down my sparse lashes. 3) The amount of transfer to my crease and to below my lashes was significant after applying the mascara. I did like the brown color though. In sum if you have small hooded eyes with sparse lashes, you can do better. I'm going back to my Clinique Lash Power which is a tubing formula that is drier, doesn't transfer and comes in a brown shade.

reviews.author: Carly M.
reviews.title: Nice color but poor mascara
reviews.body: The color is really nice but the mascara is clumpy and provides zero curl, in fact I think it makes my lashes look straighter.

reviews.author: Carla C.
reviews.title: Flakes within a couple of hours
reviews.body: Was really looking forward to trying this mascara but it flakes more than any I've used before. Not sure how this "tubing" is making it any better. Definitely won't be buying again.

reviews.author: Jodi P.
reviews.title: Not again
reviews.body: Eh ok but leaves flecks when you wash it off.

reviews.author: Twag
reviews.title: Mascara dries o it t before you can use it all
reviews.body: Liquid Lash™ Extensions Tubing Mascara - love the color and the application. Very frustrated that every tube I received only lasted a month and a half with daily use. For how much one tube of mascara costs it’s not worth it. Price is outrageous.

reviews.author: Tracy S.
reviews.title: Clumpy
reviews.body: Not worth the price. Clumpy

reviews.author: Lisa R.
reviews.title: Flakes
reviews.body: Initially I liked this mascara. The tube had a nice weight and it went on smoothly. Unfortunately, after a few hours of wear, I had small flakes on the skin under my eyes. I tried it a couple of times just to make sure and it happened each time. Very disappointing.

reviews.author: Debora R.
reviews.title: Giving it a chance, but…
reviews.body:
I have to apply this three times before it even starts to show. So disappointed.

I’ll keep trying, but don’t have a lot of hope.

reviews.author: Kristin M.
reviews.title: Not for me
reviews.body: Did not like, didn’t look like I had mascara on.

reviews.author: Beverly R.
reviews.title: Thin eyebrows and lashes
reviews.body: I do not like this mascara. It goes on too thick and clumps. And it's tough to remove.

reviews.author: RD
reviews.title: flaky, goopy & cakey
reviews.body: I wanted to love this but after trying it a handful of times, the results were the same. it flaked all over my face and eyelids and created a huge mess. I only wish I had tried it sooner as the return window closed and now I am out of the money, also

reviews.author: Laina
reviews.title: Mess
reviews.body: I purchased 1 bottle and I liked that it was quick to put in. You didnt have to layer it. It gave super length in a couple swipes. Literally after 1 week it turned into a flaky mess that slumped like no other. Dried out mess. So hey! Lets try another tube! Liked it so much the first week maybe I got a bad bottle. Should have listened to the other reviews that were similar. Same thing. One big dried out flaky, clumpy mess. Now im done.

reviews.author: Margaret J.
reviews.title: Nothing special. For $26 it should be
reviews.body: They’re terrific mascara for $15 that produced beautiful looking lashes. Thrive wants $26 for this one, and there’s nothing special about it. I was hoping for the telescopic lengthening properties it touted, but instead the product was very ordinary, and did not produce any extra extraordinary length. I do not need to overpay for ordinary.

reviews.author: Janel D.
reviews.title: Mascara
reviews.body:
I like the mascara but I ordered a colored tube of mascara also and have yet to be told when it will even be projected to arrive. 
I’m not very impressed with the communication about the other part of my order I have yet to receive.

reviews.author: Hannah N.
reviews.title: Sub par mascara
reviews.body: I was really excited to try this but unfortunately it was very clumpy and did not add volume at all nor was the color notable to highlight my blue eyes as expected. For the cost, I would not recommend.

reviews.author: Dfitz
reviews.title: Broke my lashes off
reviews.body: Broke my lashes off. At first I thought it was my imagination. I have naturally long lashes but wanted to “lift” my eyes up a bit. However, why would my lashes be suddenly shorter after using this product? Then I googled it and saw many people with the same experience. However those reviews never seemed to make it to Thrive Causemetic’s website. Hmm. I know it says to remove with warm water but WARNING if you go to bed without removing it, say goodbye to your lashes. Next morning no mascara and no lashes. Throwing it out. Will never use this or any other “tubing” mascara again. I only hope my lashes grow back.

reviews.author: Charki S.
reviews.title: Mascara
reviews.body: This mascara was just ok…. .

reviews.author: Erin
reviews.title: Flakes
reviews.body: I have been using this mascara for over a year. I love the tubing effect which makes it easy to remove. I've never had an issue w/ smudging. However, since opening my most recent purchase, I've had an incredible problem w/ flaking. All Day Long. On my face, In my eyes. It's terrible. I hate to have to look for a new brand but I'm sick of running around w/ a mirror to find the chunk of mascara in my eye.

reviews.author: Charlotte M.
reviews.title: Not for me
reviews.body: I was hoping this would be the answer to my mascara problems, but this seems just as gloppy as the rest. It also doesn’t last all day, it flakes flakes off.

reviews.author: Denise L.
reviews.title: Doesn't work for me
reviews.body: Unfortunately, I'm not a fan. I tried it once and thought I'd give it one more try. I don't like the way it gets all over my face when I'm removing it. It looks good on, easy to apply but when I removed it, it's a mess. Chunks of black all over my face. I use a cotton wisp and microcellular water.

reviews.author: Mary
reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.body: I am disappointed in this mascara. I experience a lot flaking, which is contrary to the product description and the reviews after 4 hours, most of the mascara had completely flaked of and that was without rubbing my eyes or crying/tearing. I won’t be buying this again .

reviews.author: Janie K.
reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.body: I was looking forward to using this mascara, but very disappointed when I did use it. Clumpy and not at all like I read that it would be. Too expensive for something I dont like.

reviews.author: Trina
reviews.title: Dried Out Tubes
reviews.body: I used to rave about Thrive mascara. I even have bought the travel size gifts sets and have given them as gifts to my sisters and friends but this past year something has changed. I used to easily make a tube last 3 months before you could really tell it was dried out and starts clumping too much. My last two tubes only lasted less than a month before they were too dry to use anymore. Maybe I received an off batch or had sat on a shelf too long but I was sad I had to find something different.

reviews.author: Kim W.
reviews.title: I absolutely love the black
reviews.body: I absolutely love the black mascara… I have told so many people about it but not loving this color as much, will not get it again. It looked so beautiful in the add I watched but it just looks too light for me.

reviews.author: Kristin C.
reviews.title: More irritating to eyes than what I used to purchase
reviews.body: This is more irritating to my eyes than it ever used to be. I have been using this product for years. It seems to irritate my eyes now. It's also much more expensive now.

fields.Skin Concerns: Oil Control, Acne + Blemishes, Uneven Skin, Fine Lines + Wrinkles, Puffiness

reviews.author: DeAnne R.
reviews.title: Not impressed
reviews.body: I was a little disappointed that it didn't really extend my lashes. I have tried less expensive mascara that was more impressive.

reviews.author: Yvette W.
reviews.title: Disappointed. . . Did the product lengthening property change?
reviews.body: It seems the mascara has changed since when I started using the product in 2018. It doesn't lengthen my lashes like the original product. The plum actually stung my eyes and took several minutes to dry. I did get a compliment on the color but I don't think I care for it enough to rave about it.

reviews.author: AM
reviews.title: Messy
reviews.body: This mascara doesn't have any "grab" and does not lengthen lashes. What bugs me the most is that it leaves long black flakes all over my shower when I wash my face. I had high hopes for this mascara but overall, I'm not a fan.

reviews.author: Karla S.
reviews.title: Not thrilled with it. It's
reviews.body: Not thrilled with it. It's a little clumpy. Not much color to it because it's so light.

reviews.author: Catherine D.
reviews.title: Meh. . . . .
reviews.body: Just ok. Nothing special. Will not buy again.

fields.Skin Concerns: Fine Lines + Wrinkles, Dryness, Uneven Skin

reviews.author: Tamra S.
reviews.title: Irritates eyes
reviews.body: It’s nice but irritates my eyes

reviews.author: Octavia
reviews.title: Weighs my lashes down
reviews.body: I did a before and after photo because I had a feeling it was taking away my curl, and now really adding any length, they do not look like extensions by any means. .

reviews.author: BZ
reviews.title: LOVE the color, HATE the brush
reviews.body: Really love your grey mascara! It about time someone made a grey mascara. But I absolutely hate that hard plastic brush. It scratches my eyelids. I have white eyelashes so I have to get really close to my eyelids when I put it on. I have to use an old mascara brush now. Can’t you make a brush that’s thin and soft??

reviews.author: Tammy M.
reviews.title: Does not go on as
reviews.body: Does not go on as advertised

reviews.author: Rachel
reviews.title: The color is nice but texture is tick and pasty
reviews.body: I was excited to try this mascara because of the colors it offers I got the Barry Brown color as a blonde haired girl I thought it would work well with my features. I like the color however the mascara itself is really pasty so I felt like when I was putting it on it was really chunky and making all my lashes stick together, which isn’t really the natural look I was going for. This may be a mascara that’s meant to be for full face make up looks I guess it would be nice if they made a gel mascara to give another option for people who don’t like that thick consistency

reviews.author: Elizabeth B.
reviews.title: Mascara
reviews.body: This mascara makes my eyelashes look long and separated. However, when I remove it, it comes off in pieces, which I'm worried a piece will get on my eyeball.

reviews.author: Rebecca H.
reviews.title: Not a strong difference
reviews.body: I wish I could say I loved this product, but I really didn't see a difference. I love how it covers my lashes, but getting LASH brand mascara off at the end of the day results in lost eyelashes : (

reviews.author: Kali M.
reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.body: Product arrived quickly compared to when I first purchased from them years ago. However it seems like the formula has changed feels thicker not as runny as it used to be gets clumpy when you try to do more than one coat and the color payoff isn't really there. I bought four different shades and I don't see myself going back to buy them again.

reviews.author: Robert S.
reviews.title: Crystal Brown
reviews.body: I was disappointed in this color and the consistency of this tube. The color was darker than expected, but the formula wasn't nearly as volumizing as the True Brown I had prior. The Brown was the first time I ever tried it.

reviews.author: Mare544
reviews.title: Expensive yet disappointing
reviews.body: Was looking for a mascara that did all the things Thrive Lash Extensions promised. Thought something that cost more than double my old standby did must be totally awesome. But it wasn't. The color (Elena) is so subtle, you don't see the tint. And the brush leaves clumps. Although it spread relatively well, my lashes were clumpy, short and far less than stellar. Will not buy again. Back to Maybelline.

reviews.author: Patricia P.
reviews.title: Too thick. . . lost lashes when
reviews.body: Too thick. . . lost lashes when washing off

reviews.author: Melinda C.
reviews.title: Not for me
reviews.body: Tubing effect? Didn’t see anything different. Color not the best for very dark brown eyes.

reviews.author: Kelly
reviews.title: Comes off in flakes
reviews.body: I didn't really notice anything special about this formula, but when you take it off it tends to flake and it can be difficult to get it all off.

reviews.author: S. W.
reviews.title: Tubing Mascara
reviews.body: Was disappointed with the tubing mascara. Have always used tubing, but this one clumped on lashes and bits flaked off onto eyelids and below.

reviews.author: Suzanne S.
reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.body: I expected a fuller lash with this as advertised, but My lashes stuck together and it was difficult to remove.

reviews.author: Sarah
reviews.title: Flaked on me
reviews.body: I was disappointed in the performance of this mascara. It certainly lengthens your lashes but if you have oily skin like me, expect it to flake off, a lot. It doesn't smudge though which was great. Thats been the battle for me, to find a mascara that doesnt smudge with my oily eyelids. I was not expecting flaking. Can be clumpy as well like spider leg lashes. Love the new colors.

reviews.author: Laziza N.
reviews.title: Flakes
reviews.body:
I really wanted to love this mascara, but unfortunately it didn’t meet my expectations. The brush is uncomfortable to use and tends to make a mess, requiring extra time to clean up after application.

I was especially disappointed with its performance. I wore it to a wedding, and within just an hour, it started flaking badly—something I’ve never experienced with other tubing mascaras. I ended up with noticeable flakes under my eyes, which was frustrating.

Overall, this product didn’t deliver the ease of use or long-lasting wear I was hoping for.

reviews.author: Tanya M.
reviews.title: Don’t like that it flakes everywhere when rake it off
reviews.body: Don’t like that it flakes everywhere when comes off. Also not getting length and volume that it describes

reviews.author: Cindy
reviews.title: Uncurls my lashes
reviews.body: I'm cursed with short lashes that point straight downward. I spend time/effort curling my lashes, only to have them straightened and weighed down by this mascara. I like that the product is clean and works for many, but sure doesn't work for me. I like the volumizing mascara with the fluffy brush a lot better.

reviews.author: Tessa M.
reviews.title: Too liquidy.
reviews.body: Too liquidy, coats the lash as well, but this particular formula was too wet and heavy for my lashes.

reviews.author: Jane C.
reviews.title: Bad and good
reviews.body: I received the bundle I bought I was expecting some great items. However, the only thing that really works well for me is the eyeshadow and the eyeliner. The mascara is horrible and the lipstick is not that great either and the colors is ugly. I rate this two star only because I like the eyeshadow and the eyeliner.

reviews.author: Sandy
reviews.title: Flaking
reviews.body: I love how this mascara looks and goes on but within minutes I get flaking under my eyes. By the end of the day there is not much left on my lashes. I only use mascara on my lower lashes because I ware eyelash extensions on top. I do love your eye shadows.

reviews.author: Rachel
reviews.title: Doesn’t work for me
reviews.body: Maybe it’s just me, but it just flakes around my eyes. An awful lot of money for it to be like most other mascaras :( and unfortunately I bought a handful of them thinking they’d be great :(

reviews.author: Tina G.
reviews.title: had to stop using
reviews.body: This product went on well and made my lashes look great. The problem I had was it was like an acrylic paint and when I tried to get it off pulled some of my eyelashed out. not good so I stopped using it after a few times. i was disappointed.

reviews.author: Sammy R.
reviews.title: Very disappointed
reviews.body:
I have literally seen ads for thrives’ mascara for years. I finally asked it for Christmas and started wearing it the last few months.

I will say that if you gently put it on perfectly, it can look very nice, but in general most days it either starts immediately or by the end of the day it clumps in different chunks on my eyelashes and it falls on my cheeks and it looks pretty bad. 

I even had my husband start making comments to me which that’s usually not something he would notice.

I also noticed one of my family member was having clumping eye mascara as well and then she told me she switched to thrive so I think it’s just a problem with the mascara in general 

so overall, I was very disappointed because I assumed it was one of the best mascara out there from the ads and it definitely underperformed

reviews.author: Alli
reviews.title: Used to love
reviews.body: I have previously used Brynn and loved it, but this time decided to try Crystal. First impressions, crystal did not lengthen or curl as well as my old tubes. As I wore it throughout the day it badly flaked. I don’t know if the formula has changed, or if crystal just isn’t as good, but I had no issues with my previous tubes of Brynn. I will be throwing away Crystal after just three uses.

reviews.author: Ruth
reviews.title: Different Formula Recently??
reviews.body: I’ve used this mascara for several years and it has never flaked off below my eyes until recently. I am wondering whether or not the formula has been changed. I will try one more order. Maybe I got a defective tube.

reviews.author: Lori D.
reviews.title: Liquid lash
reviews.body: I found the mascara very clumpy when applied. But I did love the creamy eyeshadow stick.

reviews.author: Julie N.
reviews.title: Great Color; Otherwise Very Meh
reviews.body: This mascara is an absolutely AMAZING color!!! I LOVE how green it makes my hazel eyes look. However, I didn't find it to be extra special in any way over any other mascara I've used--even cheap $10 drug store brands. In fact, something in it makes my eyes itch a little bit. No one but me noticed. Overall, very disappointed with Causemetics.

reviews.author: Angela R.
reviews.title: Bland
reviews.body: Expected more berry color. This is just baby poop brown. Don't waste your money.

reviews.author: Hannah T.
reviews.title: Didn’t meet expectations
reviews.body: Disappointed with this mascara bc the difference wasn’t dramatic and it didn’t last a whole night before shedding.

reviews.author: Shirley K.
reviews.title: Not my choice
reviews.body:
Very disappointed with this product - had clumping, flaking and did not like the wand/brush for applying the mascara evenly, etc.
Would NOT buy it again or recommend it for others to buy. Would like to get refund of purchase price.

reviews.author: Laura L.
reviews.title: Messy mascara removal
reviews.body: The mascara goes on pretty well but when taking it off, it breaks into tiny pieces that stick to my skin and get in my eyes. I returned it after one use.

reviews.author: Lisa L.
reviews.title: WHAT IS THIS MADE OUT OF?!?!?
reviews.body:
In my humble opinion…I would return this, if I had original packaging (all I have is the mascara box). It doesn’t lengthen. Goes on thick and clumpy. But, that’s not the worst issue…. when k remove it, it comes off like chipped paint. $30 (rounded up) a tube?!?!?!! Hate it. 
*They probably won’t show this post.

reviews.author: Ann M.
reviews.title: The mascara gets clumpy
reviews.body: The mascara gets clumpy

reviews.author: Danielle
reviews.title: Flaky mess
reviews.body: This is advertised as flake free. Within a hour of applying my cheeks are covered in black flakes. Formula is very wet and thick. I’ve tried multiple times applying this and cannot do so without making a complete mess. There’s no way to put eyeshadow on before this mascara unless you want to have black smears and spots all over it. It does give my lashes great length after a couple coats but I’m not sure the mess is worth it.

reviews.author: Kim D.
reviews.title: Might be ok if the wand was different
reviews.body: I had the same issues as others with the clumping and too much liquid on the brush. I cleaned and used a wider, thicker, curved brush from one of my other mascaras and it was better. Still doesn’t “lift” the lashes and definitely is not waterproof. So I bought a lash primer to see if that helped. Helped some but not a lot.

reviews.author: Wendy B.
reviews.title: My first purchase with thrive and I’m disappointed
reviews.body:
I was excited to try this product line after all the hype on social media and talking to a friend who uses your products 

I bought the tubing mascara and the semi permanent eyebrow gel. Received it today & was excited to try it when I got home from work. I’m deeply disappointed in both. The eyebrow gel barely shows up and the mascara does nothing to enhance my eyes. Given I am 62 I had better results from using Maybelline mascara. Perhaps this cosmetic line is just not designed for older women.
I’m going try both products again tomorrow morning to see if it’s worth keeping.

reviews.author: Dana B.
reviews.title: Extremely clumpy and honestly a
reviews.body: Extremely clumpy and honestly a cheap drugstore mascara does a much better job.

reviews.author: Jill S.
reviews.title: Nice colors
reviews.body: I ordered the Crystal and Elena Tubing Mascaras. The colors are very nice, and the brush extends the lashes. But, on the whole, I'm extremely disappointed in the product. Like all other mascaras I have purchased, this mascara clumps and flakes. I will have to go back to Lancome, which isn't perfect, but it is better than Thrive.

reviews.author: Caitlin D.
reviews.title: Disappointed- returning
reviews.body: Disappointed. Finally decided to try it and am going to return. It makes my lashes look stringy and dry. Somehow also tangles my lashes/makes them stick together.

reviews.author: LuAnn P.
reviews.title: Not a great lash mascara
reviews.body: I tried this because of the tubing technology and found it sorely lacking as far as plumping up my lashes and giving them a big look. I won't be reordering.

reviews.author: Mary B.
reviews.title: Liquid Lash Mascara
reviews.body: Loved the color, but it did not go on smoothly. Clumped—and was difficult to separate lashes.

reviews.author: Beveely D.
reviews.title: Not happy with this
reviews.body: Color was not great. Must have sloughed off because nothing showed on the lashes a few hours later.

fields.Skin Concerns: Fine Lines + Wrinkles, Visible Pores, Uneven Skin, Redness

reviews.author: Vera T.
reviews.title: Removing it is a nightmare and it clumps going on and flakes off during the day. Not for me.
reviews.body:
I'm older and wanted just a little makeup on my eyelashes. I chose the gray color and really like the color. 

HOWEVER, it clumps going on (even with only one pass on my lashes) and it flakes off during the day. 

The worst part is that removing it is a total nightmare. 

I've tried the warm water. I've tried micellar water - it doesn't matter. Little tubes left all over my cheeks and face. I spend more time trying to get them off of my face than a person should. 

I don't think I will order again because of those reasons. I'm also having more of the look I want with the Maybelline Sky High Primer. It doesnt' flake off, goes on easy and removes easily too. Plus the cost is nice. 

I also don't understand when reading through all of the reviews here that even the ones that say they don't like the product, or they will be returning the product all have 5 stars? I don't get it. That's deceiving.

reviews.author: joyce b.
reviews.title: I don’t really see any
reviews.body: I don’t really see any difference between this and a $8 tube of mascara.

reviews.author: Jessica A.
reviews.title: Very Disappointing
reviews.body: Takes FOREVER to dry

reviews.author: Barbara R.
reviews.title: Ugh!
reviews.body: I didn’t like it at all. I followed the directions and tips. It was clumpy and when dried it flaked. A big waste of money

reviews.author: Aimee B.
reviews.title: There’s Better Our There
reviews.body: Not at all what I expected. Followed the application instructions and feel that they make my lashes look worse. I don’t agree that it makes you look like lash extensions at all. Color is good so for that I gave 2 stars. I’ve had better results with other mascaras at a third of the cost. It’s a no for me. Bummer now that it’ll be wasted.

reviews.author: Alison C.
reviews.title: Not as 'holy grail' as I expected
reviews.body: This brush was not right for my lashes. The product itself was less likely to smudge, and I need that, but Clinique's high-impact mascara brush works far better in defining each lash. This product made my lashes look shorter and sparser. I think the brush itself was the issue rather than the formula.

reviews.author: carol c.
reviews.title: Love the brightener but not
reviews.body: Love the brightener but not the Mascara(flakes)

reviews.author: Stacey
reviews.title: Not what expected
reviews.body: I was excited to try this but really it’s not much different then my every day cheaper mascara. My lashes aren’t any longer thicker and don’t curve up with this? When they dry it almost feels like a soft silicon that you can stretch on your lash. Sadly I won’t be buying again. Wasnt worth the $.

reviews.author: Betty h.
reviews.title: Lashes
reviews.body: Easy to apply, I like the finished natural look. It's hard to remove and left flakes. Don't like that part.

reviews.author: Kelly D.
reviews.title: Not impressed
reviews.body: I got blackest black and it doesn’t show up like that in my lashes. It’s clumpy. Very disappointing.

reviews.author: Tammy S.
reviews.title: DISAPPOINTED
reviews.body:
I really expected this mascara to be above all others. However, even after applying several times, I barely get length or fullness. 
I won't be buying again.

reviews.author: Pat C.
reviews.title: Clumps
reviews.body: Do not like the clumping. Lashes clump together and looks awful! When removing i had flakes all over my face. Will not buy or recommend!

reviews.author: Dawn T.
reviews.title: Mascara
reviews.body: It's conditioning but it clumps and too much goes on my eyelashes. . . . kinda runny.

reviews.author: Penalope H.
reviews.title: Made my eyes itch
reviews.body: I bought the black/brown and it's a great color, but It flaked and made my eyes itch.

fields.Skin Concerns: Oil Control, Visible Pores, Fine Lines + Wrinkles

reviews.author: Cynthia A.
reviews.title: Liquid Lash extension
reviews.body: Sorry but was disappointed in this mascara. Did not look natural on me at all and flaked into my eyes causing irritation.

reviews.author: Rachael P.
reviews.title: Tubing mascara.
reviews.body: I've worn this mascara for many years and love it. Typically. This time my mascara is extremely clumpy. I am disappointed. Has the formula changed? Normally I always recommend it. But now I'm not sure that I would.

reviews.author: Claudia D.
reviews.title: I felt the mascara was
reviews.body: I felt the mascara was clumpy and flaky. Disappointing!

reviews.author: Dede W.
reviews.title: I'm not sure if something
reviews.body: I'm not sure if something changed but this tube isn't good. It clumps my eyelashes together.

reviews.author: Ronda
reviews.title: Clumps
reviews.body: Clumps a great deal

reviews.author: Madelyn D.
reviews.title: Not a huge fan of
reviews.body: Not a huge fan of the mascara. It was very clumpy. The brown just wasn’t for me personally, I loved it in soft lighting, but with bright lights or direct sunlight it almost looked purple in color. It was hands down the easiest mascara to remove, washed right off. I think it has a lot of potential!

reviews.author: Jess P.
reviews.title: Watery mess
reviews.body: Way too watery & therefore difficult to apply

reviews.author: Suzanne H.
reviews.title: Used to love this mascara
reviews.body: I have been using this mascara for years and have loved it. But, it seems like something has changed in the formula because now it is clumpy and sticky and I can no longer wear it.

reviews.author: Kristi N.
reviews.title: Clumps
reviews.body: It’s very clumpy. Nice color but not good application

reviews.author: Tash
reviews.title: False advertising
reviews.body:
I bought two mascaras as part of a promo- get a free lip stick with purchase of two. Never received the lip stick. 
As for the mascara, I feel something changed. I used it years ago and loved it. This round it is clumpy and does not go on well at all. Very disappointed for the price!

reviews.author: Marsha S.
reviews.title: Clumpy
reviews.body: It glues several lashes together and looks clumpy. I had to get one of those lash combs to get the clumps out. After I did that, it did stay on well.

reviews.author: Bob H.
reviews.title: not impressed with thrive mascara!
reviews.body: this mascara really is no different than what I buy for half of a cost. It takes forever for it to dry and it just gets smudgy just not impressed with it at all. I am an older female. I have fairly decent eyelashes and really all I see it does makes them a little more prominent does not make them longer at all.
